text: In October 2022, the parent of a Western Middle School student challenged Laini Taylor's Daughter of Smoke and Bone in the school library, taking issue with its depictions of characters smoking and discussing sex. That November, a district review committee relocated the novel and the rest of the trilogy to the high school library.
